title: Ontwikkeling van onderwijsarrangementen voor een succesvolle doorstroom vmbo-mbo-hbo
summary: This study, subsidized by the National Education Research Agency (NRO), focuses on regional collaboration between VMBO, MBO and HBO institutions. Three educational institutions, the Christelijke Onderwijsgroep Gelderland (COG), the Graafschap College and the HAN University of Applied Sciences, have taken the initiative to investigate, together with researchers from KBA Nijmegen, Oberon and HAN, how they can design tailor-made initiatives that ensure that the transitions between VMBO-MBO and MBO-HBO run more smoothly for pupils and students, thus preventing dropout
